overview: This plan retrieves frozen FY2024 evidence for 6682.HK, performs financial statement analysis, valuation, and risk assessment, then assembles a structured report with explicit citations. A verifier task ensures all claims are backed by evidence.
research_topic: 第四范式 (6682.HK) formal FY2024 frozen-input report
requirements: Cover executive summary, three statements or gaps, valuation or limitation, risks, and investment conclusion.
Emit explicitly labeled critical claims and body citations.

tasks.description: Retrieve all frozen FY2024 evidence for 6682.HK from local evidence store and Yahoo Finance snapshot. Focus on financial statements, market data, peer data, and news. Return ranked evidence records with citation-ready metadata.
tasks.expected_output: Set of evidence records with evidence_id, source, content type, and raw data.

tasks.description: Perform financial statement analysis (three statements or gaps), compute ratios, build peer comparison, perform valuation (DCF, multiples), identify risks and limitations. Use only evidence from task_001. Output critical claims with evidence_ids, tables, and valuation model artifacts.
tasks.expected_output: Structured claims with evidence_ids, tables, valuation model, risk factors, and limitations.

tasks.description: Assemble the final research report in Chinese according to requirements: executive summary, three statements or gaps, valuation/limitation, risks, investment conclusion. Embed citations from task_002 claims. Produce Markdown, HTML, and JSON outputs with references and compliance disclosure.
tasks.expected_output: Complete report in Markdown, HTML, and JSON formats with citations.

tasks.description: Verify that every material factual claim in the final report has an explicit evidence_id citation, and that the report covers all required sections. Provide pass/fail and revision notes if needed.
tasks.expected_output: Verification report with pass/fail status and revision guidance.

data_sources: Frozen FY2024 evidence snapshots for 6682.HK (local evidence store)
